reviews.text: They listened to what I wanted for my fur baby, her haircut was beautiful

This review is specifically about my most recent visit.

I’ve taken my dog to this Petco for grooming a few times, and I’ve also used grooming services at several other Petco locations. I’ve never had any issues before. In fact, I’ve always received excellent service at every other Petco I’ve visited.

Unfortunately, this experience was completely different. I hate leaving negative reviews, but I genuinely feel this one is warranted.

Before speaking with me, I overheard the groomer (Ebony) and another employee discussing how they had overbooked appointments and wouldn’t be able to complete someone’s grooming service. Shortly after, I was told they couldn’t complete my dog’s service because of her behavior.

This didn’t make sense to me. My dog has been professionally groomed many times, including at other Petco locations, and I’ve even recorded videos of her during previous appointments. She has always been calm, comfortable, and well-behaved. She’s an adult dog, so this isn’t a case of new or unpredictable behavior. The only thing she occasionally does is urinate when she’s nervous, which I’ve seen happen with plenty of other dogs before grooming. Somehow, on this visit, that suddenly became a reason not to complete her appointment.

What made the situation even more frustrating was that the explanations kept changing. Every time I addressed one reason they gave, they came up with another. It honestly felt like they were trying to justify not completing the service rather than being honest about the fact that they had overbooked.

To make matters worse, the stylist went to speak with what I assume was a supervisor, and then they both began telling the cashier things about my dog that simply aren’t true. Hearing employees discuss and exaggerate my dog’s behavior was incredibly disrespectful and unprofessional.

I left feeling frustrated, disappointed, and like I wasn’t being treated honestly. If the salon was overbooked, I would have appreciated transparency instead of feeling like my dog was being unfairly labeled to justify canceling her appointment.

I won’t be returning to this location. I’d rather drive farther to another Petco, where I’ve consistently had positive experiences, than deal with this team again.

I’ve been bringing my dog here regularly for grooming for quite some time. Sometimes he gets a full groom, and other times I bring him in for just a bath and clean-up. Overall, the staff has always been kind, and check-in/check-out is usually smooth.

However, the last couple of visits have been a bit disappointing. In the past, I was told that certain parts of the service weren’t done because it was “per customer request,” but I was never asked to modify or decline any portion of the service. If something is being adjusted from what I booked, I would really appreciate clear communication beforehand.

This most recent visit was especially disappointing. It looks like there are still long hairs left in certain areas, and the cut around his face seems rough and not well blended. It doesn’t look as polished as it usually does.

Everything else has generally been fine, but the quality of the grooming itself hasn’t been consistent lately. I’m hoping this feedback helps, as I’ve been a regular customer and just want the level of service we used to receive.
